chosen_because: GT-P008 next-round option C (FREE persistence feasibility, definitions first); authorised by GT-P009

clocks.continuous: generator W, CT stationary law pi; lifetimes in model time units
clocks.jump: jump chain P = W/q, law nu = pi q / E_pi[q]; lengths in jumps

comparators.N0: the NULL item at the same N (all rates 1); same predicates and formulas
comparators.ND: per target item: p_k = CT edge-count profile of the target law; phi_k = p_k / C(M,k); birth_k = min(1, phi_{k+1}/phi_k), death_{k+1} = min(1, phi_k/phi_{k+1}); all rates multiplied by c = E_pi_target[q] / E_pi_ND,unscaled[q]. Reversible and label-covariant; matches the CT density marginal and the CT mean event rate only, NOT the full state law, local rates, correlations or the jump-clock density marginal (reported). Analytic law pi_ND(x) = phi_|x| verified by detailed and global balance; an iterative solve (cap 20,000 lazy iterations) is a cross-check only. Rare bins p_k < 1e-12 flagged with their masses; the smallest unscaled transition rate is reported (interior rare bins make ND near-reducible). A zero bin makes ND unresolved for that item; nothing is smoothed
comparators.static_reference: ND's motif prevalence equals the static density-standardised prevalence (uniform within each k); it is reported as that and never as a dynamical result
comparators.underdetermination: ND is one reasonable dynamics at a matched density profile; any contrast against it is a fact about that comparison

deliberate_omissions.identity_tracking: not defined in E5A (Omega counts toggles, not replacements)

family_level_patterns_to_report: sustained episode lifetime with Omega ~ comparator (intact-like persistence)
Omega above comparator without longer life
path-family persistence (PATHF, PATHH, CSPH) together with their published nonzero circulation
discovery_matrix.no_threshold: no magnitude threshold, aggregate score or success criterion; magnitudes are reported beside signs
discovery_matrix.per_row: for every non-NULL family, N and predicate, against N0 and against ND: signs of lifetime (CT, jump), rho (CT, jump), Omega (flexible only) and CT prevalence; a sign is 'tie' when |a-b| <= 1e-9 max(|a|,|b|)
discovery_matrix.turnover_suffix: intact rows: intact_no_turnover (theorem); flexible rows: turnover_more / turnover_fewer / turnover_tie

estimands.density: CT and jump edge-count profiles of target and ND; jump-profile L1 discrepancy and mean jump-clock edge count
estimands.edge: present-episode lifetime of slot (0,1) by the same formulas; rho_ct = L_ct(A)/L_ct(edge), rho_jump = L_jump(A)/L_jump(edge)
estimands.episode: J_A (entry = exit flux, both computed), L_ct = pi(A)/J_A, L_jump = E_pi[q 1_A]/J_A (jumps from A states per episode, exit jump included), off-episode means (1-pi(A))/J_A and (E_pi[q]-E_pi[q 1_A])/J_A, entry-to-entry recurrence 1/J_A and E_pi[q]/J_A (algebraically dependent on the above; not independent confirmations), entries per unit time J_A and per event J_A/E_pi[q], internal events per episode (= L_jump - 1)
estimands.lagged_hub: x0 ~ pi (CT) or nu (jump); hub chosen once uniformly among maximum-degree vertices; comparison vertex uniform over all N vertices; at each lag: expected degree of hub and comparison vertex, gap, gap/gap(0), expected number of the hub's initial neighbours still adjacent and its ratio to the expected initial degree (and the same for the comparison vertex)
estimands.secondary: residual (occupation-sampled) life in both clocks and the entrance first-passage mean life, from the killed jump chain on A by BiCGSTAB (relative residual 1e-12, cap 20,000 iterations or 60 s per solve); unresolved solves are recorded
estimands.turnover: Omega = flux of eligible internal toggles / J_A (definitions note D-4, D-5); eligible share Omega/(L_jump - 1); intact predicates: required-edge internal flux (identically 0) and required-edge exit share (1); F_TRI exit shares: anchor dissolution versus loss of the last completer

frozen_identities.N0_closed_forms: NULL items: every predicate's prevalence, J, L_ct, L_jump (= M L_ct) and Omega J equal gtpersist.null_closed_forms within 1e-9; edge L_ct = 1 and L_jump = M; lag normalised gap exp(-2t) (t = lag/M) and (1-2/M)^lag, retention 1/2 + 1/2 of the same
frozen_identities.ND_fixed_point: NULL items: ND activity scale 1 and every unscaled rate 1 within 1e-12
frozen_identities.PCOMP_ND_is_scaled_NULL: PCOMP: ND rates all 1 before scaling (uniform CT law gives a binomial profile), so ND CT lifetimes x c, jump lifetimes and Omega equal N0's within 1e-9
frozen_identities.PCOMP_uniform_ct: PCOMP: CT law uniform within 1e-9 relative per state
frozen_identities.REP: replication of the published E0B cell: class-level CT and jump masses and mean rate within max(1e-10, 1e-8 x |published|)
frozen_identities.Z_item: per item: positive-rate full FREE space; stationary resolved (two starts within 1e-10, residual <= 1e-12); law symmetric under S_N within 1e-10; for target and ND: entry/exit flux balance and jump-length identity within 1e-9; relabelled instances within 1e-9 relative; intact required-edge internal flux and Omega exactly 0; every predicate classified ergodic_episodes; comparison-vertex degree constant over lags within 1e-9; lag checks: lumpability defect <= 1e-12, propagator row sums within 1e-9 and entries >= -1e-12, stationarity L1 <= 1e-9, non-dyadic semigroup <= 1e-9, lumped versus full jump chain <= 1e-10, pair-permutation covariance <= 1e-10, uniformisation cross-check (where cheap) <= 1e-9; ND detailed balance <= 1e-12, global balance <= 1e-10, density L1 and mean-rate gap <= 1e-10
frozen_identities.separation_note: no expectation on any target lifetime, ratio, Omega or lag decay

initial_conditions: primary estimates are stationary (unique class); no transient or cold-start observable is computed

lag_set.continuous: t = lag / E_pi[q] of each law (its own mean rate; ND equals the target's by calibration), plus t = 0; a translation of average activity, not an equivalence of clocks
lag_set.method: jump: exact full-space propagation; continuous: exact Pade-13 scaling-and-squaring matrix exponential of the generator lumped by the permutations fixing vertices 0 and 1 (240 states at N=5, 1,992 at N=6)

pre_freeze_exposure.agent_viewed: published values of FREE-N5-PATHF-weak_suppress (E0B hub_frame, autocorrelation; E2A hub_structure, partner frame) and two class-table rows of FREE-N6-CSPH during the audit
pre_freeze_exposure.engineering: proof fixtures: synthetic CTMCs and N<=4 FREE kernels of the six families (tests/test_gtpersist.py); timing: NULL N=6 with all rates x 2^24 and a synthetic density-only N=6 rule (dissolution 2^k); no E5A observable of any N=5 or N=6 cell was computed before freezing
pre_freeze_exposure.published: all 12 kernels are published E0B FREE cells; their class tables (hence every prevalence, the CT density profile p_k and E_pi[q], the ND inputs) are known; E0B/E0A N=5 autocorrelation times and E2A N=5 hub statistics are published (audit section 3)

predicates.F_STAR: deg(c) >= 3; eligible turnover: toggle of an edge at c, A before and after
predicates.F_TRI: anchor ab present and at least one c with ac, bc present; eligible turnover: toggle of ac or bc whose other leg is present, A before and after
predicates.I_2PATH: ab, bc present; ac free (instance (1,0,2): edges 01, 02)
predicates.I_STAR: spokes ca, cb, cd present; leaf-leaf edges free
predicates.notes: F_STAR implies F_2PATH (not independent species); a persistent anchored centre is not an unlabelled mobile structure; anchors are measurement-only

question: Without any held reference, do the existing label-covariant relational constraints sustain recognisable configurations longer than appropriate null dynamics would, and can an organisation persist through turnover of some of its constituent relations?
rule_reading: no rule reads a motif, anchor, selected hub, source label or history; all are analysis-defined

stop_conditions.amendment: any cell, predicate or estimand change stops the round
stop_conditions.round: all items or 14400 s; then stop
stop_conditions.unresolved: recorded; no retuning, no replacement cell, no changed tolerance

work_count.estimate_note: about 1-3 min per N=6 item and seconds per N=5 item, measured on synthetic N=6 fixtures (execution record); under 30 min in total expected, not promised
